practices.name: Body Cocoon
practices.shortPhrase: Hug yourself. Create a warm shell of safety.
firstSteps: Hug your shoulders or torso, let your palms feel warmth.
Take a soft breath in through your nose, long exhale through your mouth.
With each exhale, release your shoulders and jaw.
practices.line: Hug yourself and breathe out slowly to feel safe when anxiety spikes.

practices.name: Light Breath
practices.shortPhrase: Inhale – gather light in your chest, exhale – gently spread it through your body.
firstSteps: Sit comfortably. Relax your shoulders and jaw.
On the inhale, imagine a warm ray entering the center of your chest.
On the exhale, let this light spread through your arms, belly, face.
practices.line: A light, uplifting breath that spreads a warm feeling through the body.

practices.name: Inner Spark
practices.shortPhrase: Name your intention in a whisper. Let the spark ignite in your chest.
firstSteps: Place attention in the center of your chest and say inside a short 'why'.
On the inhale – gather warmth and clarity in one point.
On the exhale – let this point flare with gentle light.
practices.line: Name your intention and gather attention into one warm point before you start something.

practices.name: Slow Glow
practices.shortPhrase: Slow down. Let breath ignite a soft light within.
firstSteps: Sit (or lie) comfortably. Let your body settle heavily into support.
On the inhale, imagine a dim warm glow in your belly.
On the exhale, the light slightly expands – to chest, shoulders, face.
practices.line: Slow, soft breathing with a gentle warm image to wind down when tired.

practices.name: Earth Breath
practices.shortPhrase: Inhale – to chest, exhale – into the earth. Feel the support beneath your feet.
firstSteps: Stand steadily and widen the contact of your feet with the ground.
Inhale – lift attention from feet to chest, open shoulders, warm the center.
Exhale – release everything down through legs into earth, as if roots are growing.
practices.line: Standing breath that rises to the chest and settles into the ground.

practices.name: Wave Pulse
practices.shortPhrase: Connect breath and heart: inhale – wave rises, exhale – gentle fall.
firstSteps: Sit comfortably. Place your palm on your heart or find pulse on your wrist.
Feel the gentle beating – this is rhythm you can lean on.
Inhale – wave rises from heart to chest and shoulders.
practices.line: Feel your pulse and let the breath rise and fall with it like a wave.

practices.name: Sphere Breath
practices.shortPhrase: Imagine a sphere around your body. Inhale – it expands, exhale – gently gathers to center.
firstSteps: Sit steadily; spine is axis, crown up, pelvis heavy in support.
Imagine a transparent sphere, center in chest or belly.
On inhale sphere expands evenly in all directions: forward, back, up, down, diagonally.
practices.line: Imagine a sphere around you that expands on the inhale and gathers on the exhale.

practices.name: Light Flow
practices.shortPhrase: Inhale – lift light up spine, exhale – spread it to shoulders and arms.
firstSteps: Sit vertically: crown up, sacrum grows heavy downward.
On inhale imagine light rising from pelvis to heart and to crown.
On exhale direct light into shoulders, arms, palms – like into riverbeds.
practices.line: Sit tall and imagine light rising along the spine to wake up.

practices.name: Roots Breath
practices.shortPhrase: Inhale – to chest, exhale – into feet. Let Earth take the excess.
firstSteps: Stand or sit so feet confidently touch the ground.
Feel the weight – heels, balls, toes.
Inhale for four – fill chest with gentle warmth.
practices.line: Breathe in to the chest and out into the feet to drain off anxious tension.

practices.name: Earth Pulse
practices.shortPhrase: Tune into Earth's low rhythm. Let heart and breath calm down.
firstSteps: Place palm on chest or belly, other on lower belly.
Listen to the beating – find its calmest tempo.
Inhale – barely noticeable rise under palm.
practices.line: Hands on chest and belly, find the calmest pace of your breath and heartbeat.

practices.name: Breath of Possibility
practices.shortPhrase: Inhale – 'I accept', exhale – 'I can'. Feel the space of choice.
firstSteps: On each inhale quietly say inside: 'I accept'.
On each exhale – 'I can'.
Let words match sensations in body: acceptance expands, possibility gathers to center.
practices.line: Inhale ‘I accept’, exhale ‘I can’ — a short reset before a choice or a hard task.

practices.name: Inner Smile
practices.shortPhrase: Smile with your heart – without moving your face, from within.
firstSteps: Drop your shoulders, relax your jaw, let tongue rest freely.
Feel a warm point in your chest and let it 'smile'.
Let a wave of soft smile flow through your face, eyes, throat.
practices.line: Relax the face and jaw and let a soft inner smile spread through you.

practices.name: Amoeba Dance
practices.shortPhrase: Let joy move your body barely noticeably – on the wave of breath.
firstSteps: Keep the axis: crown up, tailbone down, breath is free.
Begin with barely noticeable swaying – 5% amplitude.
Inhale – micro-lift, exhale – micro-drop.
practices.line: Tiny swaying movements on the breath to let a good mood move the body.

practices.name: Point of Stillness
practices.shortPhrase: Find a still point within and breathe around it.
firstSteps: Close your eyes. Let your breath become barely noticeable.
Notice a point of stillness – deep in belly or center of chest.
Don't touch it with effort; breathe around it, like water around a stone.
practices.line: Eyes closed, rest attention on a still point and breathe around it.

practices.name: Listen to Space
practices.shortPhrase: Listen not to sounds – listen to the space between them.
firstSteps: Let breath be natural; allow hearing to open 360 degrees.
Notice near sounds and far ones – without naming them.
Listen to pauses from which each sound is born and to which it returns.
practices.line: Open your hearing and notice the pauses between sounds.

practices.name: Still Form
practices.shortPhrase: Freeze in a stable pose. Breath flows by itself. Be a form of peace.
firstSteps: Sit or stand comfortably; choose a simple, stable pose.
Feel the support: feet/sit bones and weight of pelvis.
Straighten spine; crown gently reaches up, chin is free.
practices.line: Hold a simple, stable pose and let the breath run on its own.

practices.name: Rest Breath
practices.shortPhrase: Slow exhale carries away fatigue. Let body sink into support.
firstSteps: Lie down or sit with full back support.
Breathe in gently through the nose, filling the belly.
Exhale slowly through slightly open lips – twice as long as the inhale.
practices.line: Exhale about twice as long as the inhale to let the body sink into rest.

practices.name: Warm Sphere
practices.shortPhrase: Create a warm sphere in your belly and nourish your whole body with it.
firstSteps: Place attention in the navel/solar plexus area.
On inhale gather warmth there – like in cupped hands inside.
On exhale let the sphere expand: to lower back, chest, pelvis, thighs.
practices.line: Gather warmth in the belly and spread it through the body when you feel drained.
